decisions.reason: The mustard reference change does not alter the terracotta pareo; its separate terracotta Pantone reference is already captured by its message 5 MODIFY.
The existing message 5 MODIFY already captures the supplied mustard and terracotta Pantone references and the associated colour-calibration plan.
The mustard block-pareo interior reference does not change the basket-weave design; the basket-weave mustard border is a separate requirement detail already captured from message 5.
The mustard block-pareo colour reference does not affect the zebra print, whose black border is a separate message 5 decision already captured.
Changing the mustard pareo from a generic colour value to a supplied Pantone reference does not alter the production-ready CMYK or seamless-repeat file requirements.
